title: 1936 Prairie: the Allerton tower gets its deep cornice
items: The belvedere on the Allerton house's tower now wears the deep cornice the winter photograph shows: a heavy corona over a metre out, about half a metre deep, over the row of brackets, where before it had a thin eave.
Above the cornice a short sloping skirt rises to a flat deck. The top balustrade now stands on that deck, back from the edge, and its rail sits at the Tribune's 73 feet.
